units.notes: C-style Dequote/Enquote. Table-driven + round-trip tests pass; minimal-quoting (upstream option 2).
Mark registry New/RecordRename/Translate. Global state replaced by parser-owned *IDMap.
Value model + Dump() re-serialization. R/C/deleteall/data<<EOF implemented but not exercised by the round-trip stream. original-oid parsed, not re-emitted (matches upstream); gpgsig stripped.

Streaming single-pass parser; exact length-prefixed 'data <n>' byte reads; callbacks + Dump. Round-trip vs real git fast-export/fast-import matches commit count + tree hashes (TestFastExportRoundTrip).
Phase 3 — literal+regex blob rewrite, binary-skip (NUL in first 8192 bytes).
Phase 2 — per-commit file-change filter/rename with invert semantics.
Phase 2 — prune-empty 'auto' + parent remap. Highest parity risk (merge parent-trim).
Phase 4 — fresh-clone/clean-tree guard; --force bypass. Load-bearing safety.
Phase 4 — spawn fast-export|transform|fast-import, wire callbacks, ref update.

excluded: full AncestryGraph (only minimal parent-remap needed for subset)
FilteringOptions CLI arg parser (gitc supplies opts programmatically)
parity_suite: internal/filterrepo/filterrepo_test.go (round-trip vs real git fast-export); fixtures referenced from upstream t/t9390 and t/t9391 (CC0)
attribution: Clean-room reimplementation of git-filter-repo (MIT). Reimplemented from format/behavior understanding; no source code copied. GPL2 test harness not ported.
local_modifications: No global mutable state: upstream module globals replaced by parser-owned *IDMap and per-record dump bookkeeping.
original-oid parsed but not re-emitted (matches upstream Dump).
